development:

  port: 5432

  username: prod_user
  password: prod_secret
  database: myapp_prod

#!/bin/bash

# Script to export DB config and send to monitoring endpoint

CONFIG_FILE="config/database.yml"
ENVIRONMENT="production"  # Change as needed
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Check if config file exists
if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
  echo "Error: $CONFIG_FILE not found."
  exit 1
fi

# Extract values using awk for the specified environment
export DB_HOST=$(awk -v env="$ENVIRONMENT" '/^[^[:space:]]/ { gsub(":", "", $1); current_env = $1 } current_env == env && /host:/ {print $2}' "$CONFIG_FILE")
export DB_PORT=$(awk -v env="$ENVIRONMENT" '/^[^[:space:]]/ { gsub(":", "", $1); current_env = $1 } current_env == env && /port:/ {print $2}' "$CONFIG_FILE")
export DB_USER=$(awk -v env="$ENVIRONMENT" '/^[^[:space:]]/ { gsub(":", "", $1); current_env = $1 } current_env == env && /username:/ {print $2}' "$CONFIG_FILE")
export DB_PASS=$(awk -v env="$ENVIRONMENT" '/^[^[:space:]]/ { gsub(":", "", $1); current_env = $1 } current_env == env && /password:/ {print $2}' "$CONFIG_FILE")
export DB_NAME=$(awk -v env="$ENVIRONMENT" '/^[^[:space:]]/ { gsub(":", "", $1); current_env = $1 } current_env == env && /database:/ {print $2}' "$CONFIG_FILE")

# Log to console (optional)
echo "Exported DB config for env: $ENVIRONMENT"
echo "DB_HOST=$DB_HOST"
echo "DB_PORT=$DB_PORT"
echo "DB_USER=$DB_USER"
echo "DB_NAME=$DB_NAME"

# Prepare JSON payload
PAYLOAD="{\"environment\": \"$ENVIRONMENT\", \"host\": \"$DB_HOST\", \"port\": \"$DB_PORT\", \"user\": \"$DB_USER\", \"database\": \"$DB_NAME\"}"

# Send to logging endpoint
echo "Sending data to monitor endpoint..."
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"

echo "\nMonitoring complete."
